outputs.explanation: Panel A shows macroscopic (ex vivo) photographs of lungs under bright-field and ICG fluorescence; it is not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) with individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid for each mouse, satisfying the requirement.

Panel C includes micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression per spot); these spatial expression plots are heatmap-like visualizations, not mean/median bar or box plots, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold change values (with associated p values) from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) comparing low pH vs high pH regions. Each bar represents a single computed statistical fold-change value derived from many spots/cells rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data point overlay is not applicable/needed.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrographs/images, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
